files.module_doc:
Deepgram STT Provider
WebSocket-based provider for Deepgram's speech-to-text API.
Supports real-time transcription with interim results.

ElevenLabs TTS Provider
Streaming text-to-speech provider using ElevenLabs API.
Supports WebSocket streaming for low-latency audio.

Provider Manager
Manages the lifecycle and switching of STT, LLM, and TTS providers.
Provides a unified interface for voice pipeline operations.

OpenAI Realtime Provider
WebRTC-based provider for OpenAI's Realtime API.
Handles bidirectional voice conversation with lowest latency.

Provider Types
Re-export all provider types from the centralized types module.
This allows components to import provider types from @/lib/providers.
